summary: Read-only pre-implementation plan audit pipeline that reality-checks and cross-reviews plan artifacts, class-tags findings as spec_gap or premise_failure, then routes Phase 5 through auto_split/prose summary/halt with run-brief finalization.

entry_points.summary: Surviving findings get canonical Class; audit-plan uses spec_gap or premise_failure only.
Class field is required immediately after Severity in every finding.
Resolve workflow.audit_to_amend and map with amend-gate-decision.py before user interaction.
audit_halt telemetry, no amend/popup, jump to Run Brief halt finalize.
Extract findings by Class, auto-amend spec_gap, render premise_failure as prose brief.
INTENT targets batch all spec_gap corrections into one amend; legacy targets one amend per finding.
Prose alignment summary replaces the old 3-way AskUserQuestion popup.
Sets outcome/next/approach and renders via run-brief before plan_audit_end.

invariants: Command is read-only for production code.
Every surviving finding in PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md has **Class:** after **Severity:**.
Audit-plan classes are spec_gap or premise_failure only.
Class is the discriminator, not severity.
INTENT-mode auto_split batches spec_gap corrections into one amend call.
force_ask emits prose alignment, not a popup.
gotchas: The embedded comment still mentions z-review-all line 716; use the current enum in z-review-all rather than hardcoding stale line numbers.
amend-gate-decision.py failures fall safe to force_ask/prose.
PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md must exist before Phase 5 extraction.
premise_failure may have no single affected task/file.
halt path must release claim before deregister when claim was acquired.
